source_anchor: Proposition 3.2(ii), all W under strong balancedness
contract: For the stated deep-linear MSE setup, strong balancedness is sufficient for finite global H0,H1 constants.

counterexample.contradiction: The loss gap is zero for every t while curvature 2*t^2 is unbounded, so no finite H0 can satisfy Definition 3.1.

independent_checker: Complete 8x8 autograd Hessian agrees exactly with symbolic 2*t^2 on the tested ray.
scope: This falsifies the proposition as printed because it omits a full-row-rank assumption on X. It does not falsify a rank-restored statement.
